query: SELECT push_id AS "push_id!: String" FROM router_pushes WHERE target_service_id=? AND target_endpoint_id=? AND target_session_id=? AND kind IN ('board-notification','subscription-activity','subscription-expiry') AND delivery_state='held' AND (retention='creationAge' OR notification_item_digest IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM local_delivery_retries r WHERE r.item_id=router_pushes.push_id AND r.scheduled_retry_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY push_id
